description_short: Designate mines with one click. Filter vanilla ore spikes, inspect ore composition, build accessways, set priorities, route Ore Sorting Plants, prepare farmland, and shape corners.
description_long: Auto Terrain Designations Create mining designations for a Mine Control Tower from the ore deposit beneath it — without manually painting every tile. Features - Create Designations: By default, scans and plans on a dedicated worker thread, then places the complete mining plan in one fast batch. A per-world setting can run new planning requests on the game thread instead. - Vanilla ore-spike correction: Filters isolated ultra-thin ore spikes that can drag mine plans deep into high-yield bedrock. - Accessways: Optionally creates ramps and routed turning accessways so vehicles can reach deeper work areas. - Ore composition: Estimates all products in current mining designations, including Rock produced by excavating bedrock. - Ore Sorting Plant exports: Configure compatible output routes, export priority, and assigned trucks for controlled ore delivery. - Farmland preparation: Helps prepare uneven terrain for farm placement. - Corner designations: Adds manual outer, inner, and Planar corner designations to the terrain designation tools. How to use 1. Select a Mine Control Tower. 2. Optionally choose an ore filter and adjust the tower settings. 3. Click Create Designations to scan the area and place mining designations. 4. Use the trash button to clear the tower's mining designations when needed. Note: Mining designation tools operate within the selected tower's managed area. Compatible with vanilla saves — the mod can be added to or removed from existing saves safely.
